Let customers bring their existing backlog with them when they join.

Today a new team starts from an empty project and re-types its work. This epic covers the importers and the review step that follows them.

## Scope BOUNDARY

Importers and the post-import review. Ongoing two-way sync is out of scope.

## Assumptions

- Teams import once, at the start, and then work only in the tracker.

## Context refs

- `docs/import-overview.md` — the current importer inventory
- `lib/import/index.ts` — the importer registry
